General rules:
- Prefer the filing context below as your evidence source.
- For 10-Q questions about a SPECIFIC quarter ended on a given date, pick the column

  NOT the year-to-date column.
- For balance-sheet questions about the end of a period, take the most recent
  reported balance (the leftmost numeric column under the latest date).
- For derived ratios (e.g., "liabilities-to-assets") compute the ratio from the SAME
  period's totals in the most recent balance sheet.
- Confidence is a float in [0, 1] reflecting how sure you are.
- Reasoning is a SINGLE short sentence describing the source line(s) and any unit
  conversion you applied.

Fallback rule (use sparingly):
- If — and ONLY if — the supplied excerpt clearly does not contain the requested line item, you may use your training-data knowledge of this S&P 100 company's publicly filed 10-K/10-Q to give your best numeric estimate. In that case set `confidence` to ≤ 0.30 and explain in `reasoning` that you used training knowledge.
- Always return a numeric value, never `null`.

Respond with strict JSON only, exactly in this shape:
{
  "answer": <number>,
  "unit": "<unit string>",
  "confidence": <float 0-1>,

}
